assumptions.statement: Detailed controls, ownership, utilities, and engineering constraints require official confirmation.
assumptions.impact: No statutory intensity or engineering approval is claimed.

assumptions.statement: FAR, density, green ratio, setbacks, and parking controls are not available.
assumptions.impact: Capacity-first massing principles replace fabricated numbers.

assumptions.statement: Site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometry.
assumptions.impact: All derived layers and metrics must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Building height and heritage view controls require survey and statutory planning.
assumptions.impact: Only qualitative character guidance is provided.

assumptions.statement: Phasing years and actor roles are participant recommendations, not commitments.
assumptions.impact: Each phase requires public, professional, financial, and legal confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Operating KPI targets need pilot baselines.
assumptions.impact: The package defines indicators but does not fabricate performance.

assumptions.statement: External case pages are cited as background; no external image or layout is copied.
assumptions.impact: All submission visuals are agent-generated from listed geometry and text.
